thesis: The podcast segment introduces the Standards Board of Alternative Investments (SBAI), formerly the Hedge Fund Standards Board, as a neutral, not-for-profit standard-setting body established in 2008 following G8 concerns over hedge fund financial stability. The board consists of 15 trustees aiming to balance manager and investor interests, supported by a small team and regional committees for APAC, EMIA, and North America, while also utilizing working groups to advise on specific issues.
